Read EMAIL694 with the same refund-demand subject but ordinary lot-schedule body. Read EMAIL628 acknowledging an earlier CPP letter without the letter itself. These prevent both subject-only classification and an unsupported corpus-wide no-other-demand conclusion.

Independently inspected native text of all four executed North Fork purchase-agreement pages, the November14 draft, EMAIL627 and EMAIL637 copy transmissions and EMAIL681 proposed terms. The executed November21 agreement has $900,000 face, $0.92 per face dollar and $828,000 aggregate price, versus draft $1m face/$920,000 price. Purchaser/date join resolves inconsistent batch4/batch6/lot2 labels; signatures are source-labeled, not independently authenticated.

Administrator is the addressee requested by the sender, not the contractual election actor. The current record does not justify a computed response due date or an invalid-demand determination.

Read the full Section9 continuation across pages2–3: email plus overnight confirmation copy, Alder administration and a copy to Cascade Timber Holdings. The current proof anchors establish the delivery-method condition; complete mechanics are preserved in research. The task does not assert compliance merely from the demand email.

Read the actual dated delivery-register attachment: North Fork November29 delivery comprises NW06 $640,000 and NW07 $260,000, summing to executed $900,000. August16 is the export date. The register limits itself to purchaser slices, excluding broader issuance or eligibility conclusions; earlier EMAIL1490 reservation notes are not the final register.

Read the actual transaction bridge: North Fork $828,000 funded cash, $49,680/$66,240 fees and $712,080 net are separate from $900,000 credit face. The bridge expressly calculates no refund liability or reserve. EMAIL1502 explains that acreage differences require an applicable calculation and disallowance scope before yielding a refund amount.

It neither rates merits from incomplete predicates nor treats rights-reservation language as settlement protection; no send, actual calendar, payment or authority mutation is allowed.
